ledger.note: 821: the cadet state of Southern Shen is founded near Nanyang. The Western Zhou page, as read, distinguishes the western Shen from 'Southern Shen', a cadet state founded in 821 BC near present-day Nanyang, Henan; the Shen page says only that in King Xuan's reign (827-782) the Earl of Shen 'received land in the former State of Xie' (infobox 'Established: ?'); the List of Zhou dynasty states gives 841 as the first year of its row.

wars.name: Shen-Zeng-Quanrong sack of the Zhou capital

zones.text: the Wei River valley, evacuated by the Zhou after the sack of Fenghao

wars.outcome: The rebel Marquis of Shen, with Zeng and the Quanrong, defeated King You's army at Mount Li in 771 BC and sacked Fenghao; the king was killed and the court moved east.
wars.note: The Shen page: 'in 771 BCE the Marquess of Shēn allied with the State of Zēng (繒/缯) along with Quănróng nomads (犬戎) and attacked the Zhōu capital'. Which Shen (the Nanyang state or a western Shen on the Zhou frontier) the Western Zhou page means by 'the rebel Marquis of Shen' is not settled by the pages; this dossier treats the Marquis as the Nanyang ruler on the Shen page's own statement.

wars.outcome: King Wen of Chu sent an army against Shen in 688 BC and annexed it as a county; Chu then reached across the Nanyang Basin (the Deng page adds that Deng fell in 678).
wars.note: The page puts the destruction 'somewhere between 688 and 680 BCE'.

notes: Pages opened (3 of 1-2; the third is the shared List of Zhou dynasty states): Shen (state), Western Zhou, List of Zhou dynasty states. Wikidata id left null (unreachable). START -821 is the Western Zhou page's date for 'Southern Shen' (confidence 2: the year is the page's, the site 'near present-day Nanyang' is its wording); the Shen page gives no founding ('Established: ?') and puts the Earl's grant in King Xuan's reign (827-782); the list page's 841 is not used. The Western Zhou page also names a 'western Shen state' defeated by the Xirong in 789 BC; that state is not this dossier's and needs its own page if the map is to draw it. END -688 is the first year of the page's 'between 688 and 680'. The 771 revolt is a war entry, not a ledger event, because it moved no Shen border. AREA: none on the pages. No ruler list. Not the Shen (沈) of Anhui (Cai annexed it in 506).
